title: You Might Already Be Too Late

scenes.narration: I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
scenes.image_query: I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.

scenes.narration: You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
scenes.image_query: You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.

scenes.narration: You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
scenes.image_query: You heard my words. You never heard my silence.

scenes.narration: You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
scenes.image_query: You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.

scenes.narration: By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.
